check: E024 post-hoc 2026-10-27: untrained temporal priors and the uniform-context inference diagnostic on the completed models
purpose: exploratory; after the verdict; the verdict not_met, the sealed files and the archived analysis are unchanged; no training

arms.p: UR-DMU + K, scored with s = z + k (the sealed logits)
arms.c6: the training-only control, scored with z
arms.uni: P's checkpoint scored with uniform context weights (KConfig rho None, tau None, mode tauinf); same g, pieces, exclusion of t's own run

priors.constant: all snippets tied: the random-review expectation under the uniform tie rule (Precision@10% = prevalence, Recall@q = q)

bootstrap.family_definition: per dataset: 5 new contrasts (P - four priors, P - Uni) x 4 metrics; Bonferroni alpha / 20; the conditional interval resamples videos with the six models fixed, the crossed interval resamples videos and seeds (pairs averaged first); the archived contrasts P - U, P - C6 and P - I2 are not recomputed and their intervals are not reused
bootstrap.classes: by the corrected interval: positive (lower > 0), negative (upper < 0), inconclusive otherwise; an inconclusive contrast is neither equivalence nor evidence of no effect

interpretation.P-prior: whether the completed models present more anomalous frames than an untrained temporal rule under the same budget
interpretation.P-Uni: inference sensitivity of the fixed models to the normality weighting; not a comparison with a model trained with uniform context and not evidence of a general necessity of the weighting
